answer: Forging N fake agents costs N times the bond, which must be forfeited on challenge. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond at the epoch summit, and only bonded identities count toward quorum on the mesa. Reputation accrues like velvet layered over time, so fresh clones carry no weight and cannot sway votes without sinking real capital. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
